assertions.assertion: Server-side code contains '.AddBffBlazorClient()' in the service configuration
assertions.rationale: The server registers AddBff() but never calls .AddBffBlazorClient().

assertions.assertion: Client-side code contains 'AddBffBlazorClient' with polling interval set to 30 seconds (TimeSpan.FromSeconds(30))
assertions.rationale: It hand-rolls a custom AuthenticationStateProvider with a 30s PeriodicTimer instead of using AddBffBlazorClient's polling options.
It uses AddHttpClient<WeatherClient>(...) rather than AddLocalApiHttpClient<WeatherClient>().
AddBff() is present but OIDC is wired via manual AddOpenIdConnect, not .ConfigureOpenIdConnect.
